On MuSiQue-Ans, the C-only model gets almost no answer score and zero support score.

- **Validation set:** 3.4 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1 (Table 4, p. 10).
- **Test set:** 3.7 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1 (Table 5, p. 11). The paper says Table 5 uses test numbers for MuSiQue, and everything else uses the validation set (p. 10).

**Comparison with other datasets:** On HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA, the same model finds supporting paragraphs well without seeing the question (67.6 and 92.0 support F1), but it "fails on ♫-Ans" (p. 11). Its answer scores there are 18.4 and 50.1 (Table 4, p. 10).

**Why support is so low:** The paper credits the "positive distractors" with 20 paragraphs (Table 7, p. 12). Support stays low with only 10 such distractors (34.6). It rises when distractors come from full Wikipedia: 77.7 with 10 paragraphs and 66.4 with 20 (Table 7, p. 12; footnote 9, p. 11).

**In MuSiQue-Full:** The C-only model gets 1.6 An+Sf and 1.1 Sp+Sf (Table 5, p. 11).
